title: Compounding Risks: Deepfake + Dual-Use AI — How Synthetic Identity Enables Trusted Access Fraud

original_idea.body:
# Compounding Risks: Deepfake + Dual-Use AI — How Synthetic Identity Enables Trusted Access Fraud

**Problem:** Deepfake technology and AI-generated identity documents compound with trusted access programs: convincing fake identities may pass KYC verification, undermining the governance mechanism entirely.

**Direction:** Analyze the specific verification steps in OpenAI Trusted Access KYC against current deepfake detection benchmarks. Estimate the success rate of a well-resourced actor (criminal, state) using current deepfake tools to pass each verification step. Compute an overall 'identity fraud success probability' for the program.

**Why it matters:** If trusted access KYC is defeated by readily available deepfake tools, the entire tiered access governance architecture is built on a false foundation.

**Relevant context:** OpenAI Trusted Access KYC; GTG-1002 fake credentials; deepfake technology state of the art 2026; Microsoft identity security blog.
